newsitem.title: USA: Group seeks seats on Rada board.
newsitem.headline: Group seeks seats on Rada board.

text.p: A group of shareholders have filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission documents requesting representation on the board of directors of Rada Electronic Industries Ltd.

International Publishing Holdings SA, Imaginative Business and Marketing Ltd, along with Rienk Kamer, an investment adviser to the two companies, filed the 13D document on December 20, several days after it was disclosed they were trying to block Rada's annual shareholders meeting from taking place that day.
All combined, the two companies and Kamer own about 1,567,122 shares of Rada common stock, or 19.8 percent.

The group is seeking representation on Rada's board of directors and is seeking an "experienced chief financial officer" and the hiring of an "internationally regarded auditing firm," according to SEC documents.
Rada has said it believes the actions are without merit.
The group said that if its demands are not met, it will seek control of Rada by calling a special shareholder meeting.
International Publishing is based in Luxembourg. Imaginative Business and Marketing is based in Gibraltar.
Rada was not immediately available for comment.
